Expand regulations based on the management status field (e.g. seasonal, monthly recurring, etc.)

Source: R/function-mstatus.R
expand_status.Rd

Function to create multiple rows of a regulation with distinct date ranges that coincide with a recurring action (based on the management status field). In this function, the management type needs to be specified.

Usage

expand_status(x, y)

Arguments

x

data default=fishhist

y

Management Type Use

Value

A dataframe

Examples

expand_status(fishhist, "FISHING YEAR")
#> # A tibble: 7,065,893 × 49
#>    FMP          COMMON_NAME_CLEAN REGION ZONE_CLEAN SECTOR_CLEAN SUBSECTOR_CLEAN

#>  5 SHRIMP FISH… SHRIMP, NORTHERN… GULF … ALL        RECREATIONAL ALL
